name: Start Webserver Authonly Architecture
description: Architecture for the make start-webserver-authonly target, covering the Compose-managed pyweb service and the simple Authorization: XYZ contract used for the local header-protected HTTP stack.

nodes.name: Architect
nodes.description: A human architect or operator who starts the authonly local stack and requests repository assets through the header-protected Python web server.

nodes.name: CALM CLI
nodes.description: The CALM CLI process invoked by the startup flow to prepare the local endpoint before the authonly stack is started.

nodes.name: Authorization Header Contract
nodes.description: The authonly access rule enforced by pyweb, requiring Authorization: XYZ for static GET and HEAD requests while leaving /health reachable without the header.

nodes.name: Static Content Tree (HTTP)
nodes.description: The static_http content tree mounted directly into the pyweb container so repository architecture files, patterns, standards, controls, and documentation are served from the local repo.

nodes.name: MY-CALM.REPO
nodes.description: A container grouping representing the local MY-CALM.REPO runtime started by the authonly target.

nodes.name: Pyweb Static Server
nodes.description: The apps/pyweb service started by make start-webserver-authonly, serving repository content from static_http over HTTP on 127.0.0.1:8080 with simple header-based protection.

relationships.description: The pyweb service serves static repository assets from the mounted static_http content tree.
Pyweb enforces the Authorization: XYZ contract for static GET and HEAD requests while preserving unauthenticated access to the /health endpoint.
The authonly docker-compose startup groups the pyweb service together with the mounted static content and the simple auth contract enforced by that service.
